title: Plastics Collapsible Containers for Human Blood and Blood Components
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 15102) covers Plastics Collapsible Containers for Human Blood and Blood Components. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 3826 :1993 'Plastics collapsible containers for human blood and blood components' issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the and Allied Equipment Sectional Committee ( MHD 13 ) and approval of the Medical Equipment and Hospital Planning Division Council. Containers that are now in use for blood and blood components are single-use sterile plastics packs with integral donor tubes and phlebotomy needles. Various transfer packs may be added to the primary collecting pack, which contains the anticoagulent solution. One of the transfer packs may contain red cell preservative solution. The text of ISO Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
